sentences.en: COP 27, the global gathering to combat climate change, has kicked off in Egypt.
sentences.zh: 旨在应对气候变化的全球盛会 COP27 已在埃及开幕。

sentences.en: Last month, the world gathered in Sharm el-Sheikh, Egypt, for the 27th UN Conference on Climate
sentences.zh: 上个月，世界各国齐聚埃及沙姆沙伊赫，参加联合国第 27 次气候变化

sentences.en: Change.
sentences.zh: 大会。

sentences.zh: 联合国气候变化大会第二十七届会议。

sentences.en: Sharm el-Sheikh is another milestone for measurement, for accountability, and for focus.
sentences.zh: 沙姆沙伊赫是衡量、问责和聚焦的又一个里程碑。

sentences.en: And finally, after years of pushing.
sentences.zh: 最后，在经过多年的推动之后。

sentences.en: Elation over a landmark compensation deal.

sentences.en: Leaders at the COP 27 climate summit in Egypt say they've reached a historic deal to help vulnerable countries.
sentences.zh: 在埃及举行的 COP27 气候峰会上，领导人们表示他们已经达成了一项历史性协议，以帮助脆弱国家。

sentences.en: For a new fund to help developing countries cope with the impacts of climate change.
sentences.zh: 设立一项新基金，帮助发展中国家应对气候变化的影响。

sentences.en: The rich nations of the world, the ones most responsible for the emissions that have caused climate change, agreed to pay into a fund to help poor nations, the ones who bear the
sentences.zh: 世界上富裕的国家——那些对导致气候变化的排放负有最大责任的国家——同意出资设立一个基金，以帮助那些承担了

sentences.en: brunt of the effects of climate change.
sentences.zh: 气候变化最大影响的贫穷国家。

sentences.en: I think it's a fundamental breakthrough that the fund is now there.
sentences.zh: 我认为该基金的设立是一个根本性的突破。

sentences.en: But in the background, an even more meaningful plan was taking shape.
sentences.zh: 但在幕后，一个意义更加深远的计划正在成型。

sentences.en: An initiative led by the tiny island nation of Barbados.
sentences.zh: 这是一项由加勒比小岛国巴巴多斯领导的倡议。

sentences.en: There could be a restructuring of the architecture of international finance, for example, which may encourage private capital to come into the battle on climate change.

sentences.en: Today, climate reporter David Gellis on the plan that could remake the way the world of finance deals with climate change.
sentences.zh: 今天，气候记者大卫·吉利斯将为您介绍这个可能重塑全球金融界处理气候变化方式的计划。

sentences.en: it was clear from the outset that one big goal of this event was going to get rich nations to agree to put tons of money into a fund to help poor countries deal with the effects of climate change.
sentences.zh: 从一开始就很明显，这次活动的一个重大目标就是让富裕国家同意投入巨资设立基金，以帮助贫穷国家应对气候变化的影响。

sentences.en: The argument, of course, being that since the rich countries, like the United States and many nations in Europe, are the ones that primarily caused climate change,
sentences.zh: 当然，其论点是，既然美国和欧洲许多国家等富裕国家是气候的主要肇事者，

sentences.en: they should be the ones to pay for the effects of it.
sentences.zh: 它们就应该为这些后果付费。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Compensation.
sentences.zh: 赔偿。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: Some people refer to this as climate reparations or loss and damages.
sentences.zh: 有些人将此称为气候赔偿或损失与损害。

sentences.en: And this idea has been contentious for a long time now.
sentences.zh: 这个想法长期以来一直充满争议。

sentences.en: But it seemed like this year, something along those lines was actually going to happen.
sentences.zh: 但看起来今年，类似的事情真的要发生了。

sentences.en: And that, we knew, would be a big storyline for the conference.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，这将是本次会议的一个重大故事线。

sentences.en: And it was.
sentences.zh: 事实也的确如此。

sentences.en: Yeah, the headlines were all about these plans for historic climate damage fund that rich countries were going to pay into so that poor countries could adapt.
sentences.zh: 是的，头条新闻全都是关于富裕国家将出资设立历史性气候损害基金的计划，以便贫穷国家能够适应。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it is a really big deal.
sentences.zh: 这确实是一件大事。

sentences.en: But there was also this other story we had been following.
sentences.zh: 但我们一直在关注另一个故事。

sentences.en: It was one that, at the end of the day, could be even more consequential than the loss and damage fund that was announced at the end of the event.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，这个故事甚至可能比活动结束时宣布的损失与损害基金更具影响力。

sentences.en: And this story had everything to do with the prime minister of Barbados, Mia Motley.
sentences.zh: 这个故事与巴巴多斯总理米娅·莫特利息息相关。

sentences.en: Mia Motley is the current prime minister of Barbados.
sentences.zh: 米娅·莫特利是巴巴多斯现任总理。

sentences.en: She's the first woman to hold that office.
sentences.zh: 她是第一位担任该职务的女性。

sentences.en: And Barbados is this idyllic little jewel of a Caribbean island nation.
sentences.zh: 巴巴多斯是加勒比海上一颗田园诗般的小岛国明珠。

sentences.en: It's also where I was really fortunate to be able to spend much of the first year of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我也非常有幸能够在那里度过了大流行第一年的大部分时间。

sentences.en: You did?
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: And in the last couple of years, Prime Minister Motley has become a huge star on the world stage when it comes to climate change.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几年里，莫特利总理在应对气候变化的世界舞台上成为了一颗巨星。

sentences.en: We come to Glasgow with global ambition to save our people and to save our planet.
sentences.zh: 我们带着拯救我们的人民和拯救我们的星球的全球雄心来到格拉斯哥。

sentences.en: Especially after a passionate speech she gave at last year's United Nations Climate Change Conference in Scotland.
sentences.zh: 尤其是她在去年苏格兰联合国气候变化大会上发表了充满激情的演讲之后。

sentences.en: And in that speech, she really made a moral case, arguing that it was the responsibility of rich nations to help poor countries adapt to climate change.
sentences.zh: 在那次演讲中，她真正从道德层面上进行阐述，认为富裕国家有责任帮助贫穷国家适应气候变化。

sentences.en: What must we say to our people living on the front line in the Caribbean, in Africa, in Latin America, in the Pacific?
sentences.zh: 我们必须对生活在加勒比、非洲、拉丁美洲和太平洋最前线的人民说些什么？

sentences.en: What excuse should we give for the failure?
sentences.zh: 我们该为失败找什么借口？

sentences.en: She, of course, presides over a country that is incredibly vulnerable to the effects of climate change.
sentences.zh: 当然，她所领导的国家极易受到气候变化的影响。

sentences.en: Barbados is a tiny island in the Caribbean.
sentences.zh: 巴巴多斯是加勒比海的一个小岛。

sentences.en: It is in a neighborhood that is often hit with hurricanes.
sentences.zh: 它位于一个经常遭受飓风袭击的地区。

sentences.en: And Prime Minister Motley has made it her mission to speak on behalf not only of just Barbados, but of other countries like hers that are bearing the brunt of more extreme weather.
sentences.zh: 莫特利总理的使命不仅是为巴巴多斯代言，也是为其他像她这样承受着极端天气之苦的国家代言。

sentences.en: And she's become such a big star in this conversation that on the first day of COP, she was given top billing alongside other people like former Vice President Al Gore,
sentences.zh: 她在这场对话中变得如此大牌，以至于在 COP 的第一天，她就被安排与前副总统阿尔·戈尔、

sentences.en: the Secretary General of the United Nations, the head of the African Union, people like that.
sentences.zh: 联合国秘书长、非盟负责人等同台亮相。

sentences.en: And now, please welcome with me Ms. Mia Motley, the Prime Minister of Barbados.
sentences.zh: 现在，请和我一起欢迎巴巴多斯总理米娅·莫特利女士。

sentences.en: So, Prime Minister Motley gets up.
sentences.zh: 于是，莫特利总理站了起来。

sentences.en: Excellencies, distinguished ladies and gentlemen.
sentences.zh: 各位阁下，尊敬的女士们、先生们。

sentences.en: And it's in this speech that she delivers what I think is the big story to come out of COP27, and in fact is one of the biggest stories in the climate conversation right now.
sentences.zh: 正是通过这次演讲，她发表了我认为 COP27 产生的最大新闻，事实上也是当前气候对话中最大的新闻之一。

sentences.en: I come from a small island state that has high ambition, but that is not able to deliver on that high ambition
sentences.zh: 我来自一个有着宏大雄心却无法实现这种宏大雄心的小岛国，

sentences.en: because the global industrial strategy that we have has fault lines in it.
sentences.zh: 因为我们拥有的全球工业战略存在裂痕。

sentences.en: Our ability to access electric cars or our ability to access batteries or photovoltaic panels
sentences.zh: 我们获取电动汽车的能力，或者我们获取电池或光伏电池板的能力，

sentences.en: are constrained by those countries that have the dominant presence and can produce for themselves.
sentences.zh: 受到了那些占据主导地位并能自己生产的国家的限制。

sentences.en: But the global south remains at the mercy of the global north on these issues.
sentences.zh: 但在这些问题上，全球南方仍然任由全球北方摆布。

sentences.en: It was in that speech that she really laid out her vision for how the rich nations of the world
sentences.zh: 正是在那次演讲中，她真正阐述了她对世界富裕国家如何

sentences.en: could fundamentally change the way they're approaching this problem of helping poor nations adapt to climate change.
sentences.zh: 从根本上改变其解决帮助贫穷国家适应气候变化这一问题的方法的愿景。

sentences.en: This world looks still too much like it did when it was part of an imperialistic empire.
sentences.zh: 这个世界看起来依然很像它作为帝国主义帝国一部分时的样子。

sentences.en: The global north borrows between interest rates of between 1% to 4%.
sentences.zh: 全球北方的借贷利率在 1% 到 4% 之间。

sentences.en: The global south of 14%.
sentences.zh: 而全球南方则是 14%。

sentences.en: We believe that we have a plan.
sentences.zh: 我们相信我们有一个计划。

sentences.en: We believe that there can be the establishment of a climate mitigation trust that unlocks $5 trillion of private sector savings.
sentences.zh: 我们相信可以建立一个气候缓解信托基金，释放 5 万亿美元的私营部门储蓄。

sentences.en: We believe as well that the time has come for the introduction of natural disaster and pandemic clauses in our debt instruments.
sentences.zh: 我们同样相信，在我们的债务工具中引入自然灾害和疫情条款的时机已经成熟。

sentences.en: And finally, we believe that the multilateral development banks have to reform.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们相信多边开发银行必须进行改革。

sentences.en: Yes, it is time for us to revisit Bretton Woods.
sentences.zh: 是的，是我们重新审视布雷顿森林体系的时候了。

sentences.en: Here she is specifically calling out the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund.
sentences.zh: 在这里，她明确点名了世界银行和国际货币基金组织。

sentences.en: These banking institutions that were created decades ago at this meeting called Bretton Woods
sentences.zh: 这些银行业机构是几十年前在名为布雷顿森林的会议上创建的，

sentences.en: and that are still central to the system that she thinks is totally failing developing countries.
sentences.zh: 并且至今仍处于她认为彻底让发展中国家失望的体系的核心。

sentences.en: I ask the people of the world and not just the leaders, therefore,
sentences.zh: 因此，我呼吁世界人民，而不仅仅是领导人，

sentences.en: to hold us accountable and to ask us to act in your name to save this earth and to save the people of this earth.
sentences.zh: 来监督我们，要求我们以你们的名义采取行动，以拯救这个地球和这地球上的人民。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So with that speech, she's really proposing a pretty gigantic reshaping of how some of the biggest global financial institutions work.
sentences.zh: 因此，通过这次演讲，她实际上提出了对一些全球最大金融机构运作方式的巨大重塑。

sentences.en: Well, can you explain why what she's saying is such a big deal?
sentences.zh: 那么，你能解释一下为什么她所说的是一件如此重大事情吗？

sentences.en: So let's break it down.
sentences.zh: 让我们来剖析一下。

sentences.en: She mentioned Bretton Woods and the need for a new Bretton Woods.
sentences.zh: 她提到了布雷顿森林体系以及建立新布雷顿森林体系的必要性。

sentences.en: And what she's talking about was this conference that took place in the waning days of World War II.
sentences.zh: 她所说的就是第二次世界大战末期举行的这次会议。

sentences.en: At Bretton Woods, New Hampshire, delegates from 44 allied and associate countries arrived for the opening of the United Nations Monetary and Financial Conference.
sentences.zh: 在在新罕布什尔州的布雷顿森林，来自 44 个同盟国和联系国的代表出席了联合国货币金融会议的开幕式。

sentences.en: The finance ministers, for the most part, got together in Bretton Woods, New Hampshire, at the Mount Washington Hotel.
sentences.zh: 财政部长们大多聚集在新罕布什尔州布雷顿森林的华盛顿山酒店。

sentences.en: They will work in the seclusion of this White Mountains resort.
sentences.zh: 他们将在白山度假村的隐秘环境中工作。

sentences.en: And tried to sketch out what a integrated, post-war global economic system might look like.
sentences.zh: 并试着勾勒出一个一体化的、战后的全球经济体系会是什么样子。

sentences.en: The world cannot endure half skyscraper and half rubble.
sentences.zh: 世界不能一半是摩天大楼，另一半是废墟。

sentences.en: And so the World Bank was set up to provide loans to mostly European countries that were trying to recover from the war.
sentences.zh: 因此成立了世界银行，向主要试图从战争中恢复的欧洲国家提供贷款。

sentences.en: Because this war had devastated nations around the globe.
sentences.zh: 因为这场战争摧毁了全球各国的国家。

sentences.en: We discussed our plans for the stabilization of world currencies.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论了稳定世界货币的计划。

sentences.en: And then the IMF was created to help stabilize currencies and economies and make sure that
sentences.zh: 随后创立了国际货币基金组织，以帮助稳定货币和经济，并确保

sentences.en: sovereign states wouldn't default and that they were going to be reliable actors on the world stage.
sentences.zh: 主权国家不会违约，并将成为世界舞台上可靠的参与者。

sentences.en: And not sort of create these shocks to the system that would have unintended consequences that could throw the whole global economic system into turmoil.
sentences.zh: 而不是在系统中制造那些会产生意想不到后果并使整个全球经济体系陷入混乱的冲击。

sentences.en: And to create a foundation for lasting peace.
sentences.zh: 并为持久和平奠定基础。

sentences.en: So by the 1970s, most of the countries wrecked by the war were mostly back on their feet.
sentences.zh: 因此，到了20世纪70年代，绝大多数被战争破坏的国家基本上都恢复了元气。

sentences.en: But in an increasingly globalized world, the World Bank really shifted its approach.
sentences.zh: 但在日益全球化的世界中，世界银行确实转变了它的方法。

sentences.en: Last week, help came in the form of an $85 million loan from the World Bank.
sentences.zh: 上周，援助以世界银行8500万美元贷款的形式到来。

sentences.en: There were all of these other countries that were trying to get out of poverty.
sentences.zh: 还有所有这些其他试图摆脱贫困的国家。

sentences.en: Since 1980, it's almost tripled the amount of money it loans to economically troubled countries like Ethiopia.
sentences.zh: 自1980年以来，它向埃塞俄比亚等陷入经济困境的国家发放的贷款金额几乎增加了两倍。

sentences.en: In Africa, in Asia, in South America, the World Bank started making loans to those countries with the express intent of trying to create new economic opportunities
sentences.zh: 在非洲、亚洲、南美洲，世界银行开始向这些国家提供贷款，其明确意图是努力创造新的经济机会

sentences.en: that would help people get out of poverty and into the middle class.
sentences.zh: 这将帮助人们摆脱贫困并进入中产阶级。

sentences.en: The deal worked.
sentences.zh: 这笔交易成功了。

sentences.en: In a generation, says the World Bank, China lifted $500 million out of poverty.
sentences.zh: 世界银行表示，在一代人的时间里，中国使5亿人摆脱了贫困。

sentences.en: And that's more or less where things stand today.
sentences.zh: 这差不多就是目前的现状。

sentences.en: But what Prime Minister Motley is saying now is that these institutions just aren't working anymore.
sentences.zh: 但莫特利总理现在所说的是，这些机构已经不再起作用了。

sentences.en: The World Bank and the IMF, which were set up to help rebuild the world after the war and then to bring countries out of poverty, are just not equipped to deal with the particular
sentences.zh: 世界银行和国际货币基金组织建立之初是为了帮助战后重建世界，然后帮助各国摆脱贫困，但它们根本没有能力应对特定的

sentences.en: challenges that poor countries have today when it comes to things like climate change and the repeated devastation that comes from these droughts, floods, fires, and storMs.
sentences.zh: 贫困国家今天在气候变化以及干旱、洪水、火灾和风暴等造成的反复破坏方面所面临的挑战。

sentences.en: At the end of the day, she's saying that these institutions, which were designed to help get poor countries out of poverty, are now in fact helping reinforce it.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，她说，这些原本旨在帮助贫困国家摆脱贫困的机构，现在事实上正在帮助巩固贫困。

sentences.en: But how?
sentences.zh: 但怎么会这样？

sentences.en: Like, how would they be reinforcing it?
sentences.zh: 比如，它们怎么会巩固贫困呢？

sentences.en: Okay, so when one of these storms, for example, hits a small country, they often need hundreds of millions of dollars or sometimes billions of dollars to recover.
sentences.zh: 好吧，例如，当其中一场风暴袭击一个小国家时，它们通常需要数亿美元或有时数十亿美元来恢复。

sentences.en: And that's money that most of these countries don't just have lying around.
sentences.zh: 而这笔钱并不是大多数这些国家随随便便就能拿出来的。

sentences.en: So some countries, the poorest of the poor, they get international aid from other countries and non-governmental organizations.
sentences.zh: 因此，一些国家，即最贫困的国家，从其他国家和非政府组织获得国际援助。

sentences.en: But most countries are forced to take out loans when these big disasters hit.
sentences.zh: 但大多数国家在大灾难袭来时被迫贷款。

sentences.en: But these are not the kind of investments that most traditional banks are very comfortable making.
sentences.zh: 但这些并不是大多数传统银行愿意进行的投资。

sentences.en: Instead, they are viewed as relatively risky investments.
sentences.zh: 相反，它们被视为相对有风险的投资。

sentences.en: Risky not only because these countries are often on somewhat shaky ground financially to begin with
sentences.zh: 之所以有风险，不仅是因为这些国家本来在财务上就往往有些根基不稳

sentences.en: and maybe don't have the greatest GDP, but also because these are areas where the storms are bad and getting worse.
sentences.zh: 也许没有最高的GDP，还因为这些地区的风暴很严重而且还在恶化。

sentences.en: And even if they are able to successfully recover from one storm, it could only be a matter of time
sentences.zh: 而且即使它们能够成功从一场风暴中恢复过来，这也可能只是时间问题

sentences.en: before there's another disaster creating more havoc and making it even harder for those countries to pay back that original loan.
sentences.zh: 在另一场灾难制造更多混乱之前，这将使这些国家更难以偿还原来的贷款。

sentences.en: And so for that reason, the private lenders charge these huge interest rates.
sentences.zh: 因此出于这个原因，私人放贷机构收取巨额利率。

sentences.en: Yeah, not a great option for these countries.
sentences.zh: 是的，对这些国家来说这不是一个好选择。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so another option is to turn to the World Bank and the IMF.
sentences.zh: 因此，另一个选择是求助于世界银行和国际货币基金组织。

sentences.en: So how does it work borrowing from those institutions?
sentences.zh: 那么向这些机构借款是如何运作的呢？

sentences.en: Well, the World Bank and the IMF often actually give better rates than countries might find on the private market.
sentences.zh: 嗯，世界银行和国际货币基金组织实际提供的利率往往比国家在私人市场上能找到的更好。

sentences.en: But those rates can still be pretty high, and they often come with strings attached.
sentences.zh: 但这些利率仍然可能相当高，而且通常附带条件。

sentences.en: What's that mean?
sentences.zh: 那是什么意思？

sentences.en: That means when a country takes on one of these big loans, they have to promise to tighten their belts, basically.
sentences.zh: 这意味着当一个国家承担其中一笔大额贷款时，他们基本上必须承诺勒紧裤腰带。

sentences.en: And often what happens to accommodate that is governments cut spending on things like schools, hospitals, police.
sentences.zh: 通常为了适应这一点而发生的情况是，政府削减对学校、医院、警察等方面的支出。

sentences.en: But why?
sentences.zh: 但为什么？

sentences.en: Like, why are they making that demand?
sentences.zh: 比如，他们为什么要提出这种要求？

sentences.en: Because in this system of international finance and debt, the institutions that lend the money put a premium on getting repaid.
sentences.zh: 因为在这个国际金融和债务体系中，放贷机构将确保收回贷款放在首位。

sentences.en: Even if they're lending money for the recovery of a storm.
sentences.zh: 即使他们借钱是为了风暴后的恢复。

sentences.en: Once that money goes out the door, their first, second, and third concern is making sure that the countries they lend it to are going to be capable of paying it back one day.
sentences.zh: 一旦这笔钱贷出去，他们第一、第二和第三关心的就是确保他们借贷的国家将来有能力偿还。

sentences.en: And sometimes that means making the countries that accepted that money restrict the ways in which they can spend the money that they do have.
sentences.zh: 有时这意味着迫使接受这笔钱的国家限制他们使用现有资金的方式。

sentences.en: What does all of that mean practically for a country like Barbados?
sentences.zh: 对巴巴多斯这样的国家来说，这一切在实践中意味着什么？

sentences.en: So what it means is countries like Barbados are stuck in this cycle of debt and disaster.
sentences.zh: 所以这意味着像巴巴多斯这样的国家陷入了债务和灾难的循环中。

sentences.en: Storms come with increasing intensity and frequency.
sentences.zh: 风暴以越来越高的强度和频率袭来。

sentences.en: They borrow money, but then have more and more debt that they have to repay.
sentences.zh: 他们借钱，但随后必须偿还越来越多的债务。

sentences.en: And they're stuck paying back debt, trying to recover from one storm, and never having the opportunity to prepare for the next storm,
sentences.zh: 他们陷入偿还债务、试图从一场风暴中恢复的困境，永远没有机会为下一场风暴做准备

sentences.en: let alone grow their economies in all the ways that are going to make life better for their population.
sentences.zh: 更不用说以各种能够改善其人民生活的方式发展经济了。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So a country takes on all this debt after a storm, barely gets back on their feet before another storm hits,
sentences.zh: 所以一个国家在风暴后承担了所有这些债务，在另一场风暴袭来之前勉强恢复过来

sentences.en: and never really is able to invest in becoming resilient against these storMs.
sentences.zh: 并且从来没有真正能够投资于增强抵御这些风暴的能力。

sentences.en: Nor are they able to invest in their economies because they have to pay back all these loans firSt.
sentences.zh: 他们也无法投资于他们的经济，因为他们必须首先偿还所有这些贷款。

sentences.en: So that's what you mean when you say the cycle of debt and disaster.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是你所说的债务和灾难循环的意思。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that's what Mia Motley is talking about when she's saying this whole system is keeping developing countries down.
sentences.zh: 这就是米亚·莫特利在说整个体系正在拖累发展中国家时所谈论的内容。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So how is she proposing to fix this?
sentences.zh: 那么她提议如何解决这个问题？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So they made a plan, and it's the one she was talking about at COP, and it's called the Bridgetown Initiative, named after the capital of Barbados, Bridgetown.
sentences.zh: 所以他们制定了一个计划，也就是她在气候大会上谈到的那个计划，被称为“布里奇敦倡议”，以巴巴多斯首都布里奇敦命名。

sentences.en: And it's basically three things.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是三件事。

sentences.en: Number one, they want to make a lot more money available.
sentences.zh: 第一，他们希望提供更多的资金。

sentences.en: They say that these institutions could be lending substantially more money,
sentences.zh: 他们表示，这些机构可以借出多得多的资金，

sentences.en: and they want to make a series of technical changes that would essentially unlock a lot of the money that they say is already there but sitting on the sidelines.
sentences.zh: 他们希望进行一系列技术变革，从根本上释放大量他们所说已经存在但处于闲置状态的资金。

sentences.en: Not only for disaster response, but for preparedness work, for helping countries become more resilient.
sentences.zh: 不仅用于灾难响应，还用于防灾工作，帮助国家变得更有韧性。

sentences.en: And for example, strengthen a hospital and make sure it's ready for the next big storm that comes bearing down on a little island.
sentences.zh: 例如，加固一家医院，确保它为即将来袭一个小岛的下一场大风暴做好准备。

sentences.en: The next thing they want to do is change some of the terms around how this debt is issued.
sentences.zh: 他们想做的第二件事是改变关于这种债务发行的一些条款。

sentences.en: Namely, they want to ensure that when a disaster hits,
sentences.zh: 也就是，他们希望确保当灾难袭来时，

sentences.en: countries aren't expected to keep servicing that debt when they need to be taking care of people who are out on the street because they just lost their home.
sentences.zh: 不指望国家在需要照顾那些因为失去家园而流落街头的人时继续偿还债务。

sentences.en: So this idea of a hurricane cause or a natural disaster cause would fundamentally sort of make it easier for countries that did assume this debt to be able to pay it back.
sentences.zh: 因此，飓风条款或自然灾害条款的想法基本上会使承担了这笔债务的国家更容易偿还债务。

sentences.en: And the third big thing they want to do is to use money that they say is already there in these systems to effectively seed a new trust that would leverage private sector money.
sentences.zh: 他们想做的第三件大事是利用他们所说这些系统中已经存在的资金，有效地启动一个新的信托基金，以撬动私营部门的资金。

sentences.en: The idea is that this big new pot of private money, which could be trillions of dollars,
sentences.zh: 这个想法是，这笔庞大的新的私人资金池（可能是数万亿美元），

sentences.en: would fund things like renewable energy projects in poor countries and help them wean themselves off fossil fuels.
sentences.zh: 将资助穷国的可再生能源项目等事情，并帮助他们摆脱对化石燃料的依赖。

sentences.en: Okay, so they're not asking to say, you know, do away with the World Bank and the IMF.
sentences.zh: 好吧，所以他们不是要求，你知道的，废除世界银行和国际货币基金组织。

sentences.en: What they're saying is these institutions need to be tweaked, but need to be tweaked pretty substantially.
sentences.zh: 他们所说的是这些机构需要调整，但需要进行相当实质性的调整。

sentences.en: And they need to make more money available.
sentences.zh: 他们需要提供更多的资金。

sentences.en: They need to, when they do make the money available, make it much more flexible in terms of how the countries themselves spend it, right?
sentences.zh: 当他们提供资金时，他们需要就国家本身如何使用这些资金提供更大的灵活性，对吧？

sentences.en: And finally, it sounds like they're proposing acting as a kind of guarantor sort of security deposit to all of this bigger, much more substantial private investment.
sentences.zh: 最后，听起来他们提议充当所有这些规模更大、实质得多的私人投资的某种担保人或保证金。

sentences.en: And that would unlock all of this additional new money for them to be able to protect themselves with.
sentences.zh: 这将为他们释放所有这些额外的资金，使他们能够保护自己。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They're not saying abolish the World Bank and the IMF.
sentences.zh: 他们不是说要废除世界银行和国际货币基金组织。

sentences.en: They're saying we need you more than ever,
sentences.zh: 他们是说我们比以往任何时候都更需要你们，

sentences.en: but we need you to act in a fundamentally different way to address what is a fundamentally new and unprecedented crisis that global developing countries are facing in the form of climate change.
sentences.zh: 但我们需要你们以根本不同的方式行事，以应对全球发展中国家在气候变化形式外面临的根本上崭新且前所未有的危机。

sentences.en: It's also, and here's the most meaningful part about it, it's not just straight up cash from rich countries.
sentences.zh: 这也是，这里最由意义的部分在于，它不仅仅是来自富裕国家的直接现金。

sentences.en: It's not them just asking rich nations to give away trillions of dollars every year to clean up disasters caused by climate change in other parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 这不是他们只是要求富裕国家每年捐出数万亿美元来清理世界其他地方由气候变化引起的灾难。

sentences.en: It's capitalism.
sentences.zh: 这是资本主义。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And it's because of that, that a lot of people say that this thing could not only work, but be way more impactful than climate reparations.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，许多人表示，这不仅行得通，而且比气候赔偿更具影响力。

sentences.en: And the reason the Bridgetown initiative is this way, the reason it diverges from this longstanding strategy of asking rich countries for climate reparations,
sentences.zh: 布里奇敦倡议之所以是这样，它之所以背离了向富裕国家索要气候赔偿的长期策略，

sentences.en: is largely because of the main architect behind it, a man named Avinash Persaud.
sentences.zh: 很大程度上是因为它背后的主要架构师，一个名叫阿维纳什·佩绍德的人。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·罗森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重构者》，一个专注于设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you,
sentences.zh: 甚至早在我在黑胶唱片时代在夜总会打碟的时候，你每天晚上都要带300件你最珍贵的财产去工作，

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 你把一个DJ台变成了这个美丽的50年历史文物的活体快闪博物馆。

sentences.zh: 现在即可在您最喜爱的播客平台上收听来自Audemars Piguet的《重构者》。

sentences.zh: 订阅《纽约时报》，立即下载时报应用，即可免费访问30天。

sentences.en: So what do we need to know about Avinash Persaud, the guy who's behind the Bridgetown initiative?
sentences.zh: 那么我们需要了解关于布里奇敦倡议幕后推手阿维纳什·佩绍德的什么信息呢？

sentences.en: Well, there's actually sort of a remarkable backstory that explains how he's in the middle of this thing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，其实有一个不同寻常的背景故事解释了他为什么会处于这件事的中心。

sentences.en: Avi.
sentences.zh: 阿维。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm good.
sentences.zh: 我很好。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: So Avinash Persaud, some people call him Avi, is a man who worked at the highest levels of finance in London, but is actually from Barbados.
sentences.zh: 所以阿维纳什·佩绍德，有些人叫他阿维，是一个曾在伦敦金融界最高层工作过、但实际上来自巴巴多斯的人。

sentences.en: Well, I was born in Barbados.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我出生在巴巴多斯。

sentences.en: I didn't have family there.
sentences.zh: 我那里没有家人。

sentences.en: My parents moved to Barbados.
sentences.zh: 我的父母搬到了巴巴多斯。

sentences.en: They had been living in Guyana.
sentences.zh: 他们之前住在圭亚那。

sentences.en: He goes to the very prestigious London School of Economics.
sentences.zh: 他去了声誉卓著的伦敦政治经济学院。

sentences.en: And I'm at LSC, age 18.
sentences.zh: 我在伦敦政经学院，18岁。

sentences.en: Where he happens to meet a fellow Barbadian, a woman named Mia Motley.
sentences.zh: 在那里他碰巧遇到了一位同胞巴巴多斯人，一个名叫米亚·莫特利的女性。

sentences.en: Mia, even back then, Mia was holding court.
sentences.zh: 米亚，甚至在那个时候，米亚就在侃侃而谈。

sentences.en: They start hanging out in the same social circles at the London School of Economics.
sentences.zh: 他们开始在伦敦政治经济学院的同一个社交圈里闲逛。

sentences.en: My girlfriend invites me around to this home in Golders Green.
sentences.zh: 我的女朋友邀请我去戈尔德斯格林的这个家。

sentences.en: Mia was in this student flat in Golders Green, lying on a sort of sofa with the remote control in her hand and a cigarette in the other,
sentences.zh: 米亚在戈尔德斯格林的这个学生公寓里，手里拿着遥控器，另一只手拿着一根烟，躺在某种沙发上，

sentences.en: zapping through channels and just talking away to everyone.
sentences.zh: 不停地换台，跟每个人聊个没完。

sentences.en: And I'm sort of subtly enthralled by this person because she was like a queen, even at age 18.
sentences.zh: 我不知不觉地被这个人迷住了，因为她就像一个女王，甚至在18岁时就是如此。

sentences.en: And people would come and pay homage.
sentences.zh: 人们会来朝拜。

sentences.en: You know, it was like a court visit.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就像是一次朝廷拜访。

sentences.en: But after school, their paths diverge.
sentences.zh: 但在学校毕业后，他们的道路分叉了。

sentences.en: Mia Motley goes back to Barbados.
sentences.zh: 米亚·莫特利回到了巴巴多斯。

sentences.en: She's from a political family there and starts rising through the ranks of politics.
sentences.zh: 她来自当地一个政治家庭，并开始在政坛步步高升。

sentences.en: In 1994, she becomes the youngest Barbadian ever to be elected to Parliament.
sentences.zh: 1994年，她成为巴巴多斯历史上最年轻的议会选举当选人。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Avi goes on to have what becomes a rather extraordinary career in finance, working for J.P.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，阿维继续在金融界开展了他可以说是相当非凡的职业生涯，为摩根大通、

sentences.en: Morgan, State Street, and really rising to the heights of international finance.
sentences.zh: 道富银行工作，真正登上了国际金融的巅峰。

sentences.en: And eventually, Mia persuades Avi to come back to Barbados, where she could really use his help.
sentences.zh: 最终，米亚说服阿维回到巴巴多斯，她真的很需要他的帮助。

sentences.en: He knows his way around international economics, and that's a valuable skill set that she wants to draw upon.
sentences.zh: 他精通国际经济学，这是她想要利用的宝贵技能。

sentences.en: And so around 2007, he packs up his family and moves back.
sentences.zh: 所以在2007年前后，他收拾好行李带着家人搬了回去。

sentences.en: And from 2007, I write every budget she does and every budget reply.
sentences.zh: 从2007年开始，她做的每一份预算和每一份预算回应都是我写的。

sentences.en: And so Avi is working with Motley now.
sentences.zh: 所以阿维现在和莫特利一起工作。

sentences.en: And then in 2017, a pair of devastating hurricanes hits the Caribbean.
sentences.zh: 然后在2017年，两场毁灭性的飓风袭击了加勒比地区。

sentences.en: So in 2017, we had the worst hurricane season in the Caribbean.
sentences.zh: 所以在2017年，我们经历了加勒比地区最糟糕的飓风季。

sentences.en: Two hurricane category 5s.
sentences.zh: 两个五级飓风。

sentences.en: It wipes out Dominica.
sentences.zh: 它摧毁了多米尼克。

sentences.en: And one of the hardest hit places was the neighboring island of Dominica.
sentences.zh: 受灾最严重的地区之一是邻近的岛国多米尼克。

sentences.en: I get a call from Mia.
sentences.zh: 我接到了米亚的电话。

sentences.en: Mia says, you've got to go and help them.
sentences.zh: 米亚说，你必须去帮帮他们。

sentences.en: And Mia asks Avi to go over there and see how he can help.
sentences.zh: 米亚请阿维过去看看他能如何帮忙。

sentences.en: And I realize, Dominica, tiny country, the world will forget Dominica in five days.
sentences.zh: 我意识到，多米尼加作为一个小国，世界在五天内就会把多米尼加忘得精光。

sentences.en: How do I stop them forgetting Dominica in five days?
sentences.zh: 我怎么才能阻止他们在五天内忘记多米尼加呢？

sentences.en: I'm thinking, you know, within a few weeks, there'll be a bad train crash in Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 我在想，你知道的，几周内巴基斯坦就会发生一起严重的火车相撞事故。

sentences.en: No one will remember Dominica.
sentences.zh: 没有人会记得多米尼加。

sentences.en: And Avi came away from that resolved to try to figure out what he could do to make countries like Dominica
sentences.zh: 埃维带着这个决心离开，他试图找出自己能做些什么，让像多米尼加

sentences.en: and also Barbados better prepared to weather these disasters to deal with the effects of terrible storms even after the eyes of the world had moved on.
sentences.zh: 以及巴巴多斯这样的国家做好更充分的准备，以应对这些灾难，即便在世界的目光转移之后，也能应对可怕风暴带来的影响。

sentences.en: So Avi realizes that whatever plan he comes up with needs to have two important features.
sentences.zh: 因此，埃维意识到他想出的任何计划都需要具备两个重要特征。

sentences.en: Number one, he can't just be asking for handouts, charity from rich countries to get out of this cycle.
sentences.zh: 第一，他不能只是乞求施舍，向富裕国家索取慈善捐款来摆脱这个循环。

sentences.en: Because the Caribbean loves to beg.
sentences.zh: 因为加勒比地区喜欢乞讨。

sentences.en: But it's kind of a, it's become a default position.
sentences.zh: 但某种程度上，这已经变成了一种默认的立场。

sentences.en: We're in a terrible place.
sentences.zh: 我们身处一个糟糕的境地。

sentences.en: We're in a front line.
sentences.zh: 我们身处最前线。

sentences.en: You need to help us.
sentences.zh: 你们需要帮帮我们。

sentences.en: Because you help, you cause this.
sentences.zh: 因为你们提供帮助，灾难正是你们造成的。

sentences.en: You need to help us.
sentences.zh: 你们需要帮帮我们。

sentences.en: And you know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: It hits you, but no one follows that up.
sentences.zh: 这触动了你，但没有人会付诸后续行动。

sentences.en: What they will do is they will send some scraps.
sentences.zh: 他们会做的只是施舍一些残羹冷炙。

sentences.en: And he doesn't want Mia Motley to be in a position of asking for those scraps.
sentences.zh: 他不想让米娅·莫特利处于索要这些残羹冷炙的境地。

sentences.en: You've had a number of people doing motor things.
sentences.zh: 你们有很多做汽车相关事情的人。

sentences.en: But the difference is they never had a solution.
sentences.zh: 但不同之处在于，他们从来没有解决方案。

sentences.en: Their story was, whoa, me.
sentences.zh: 他们的故事是，天哪，我太惨了。

sentences.en: This is terrible.
sentences.zh: 这太可怕了。

sentences.en: You need to do something about it.
sentences.zh: 你们需要为此做点什么。

sentences.en: And the world does not take to begging.
sentences.zh: 而世界并不买账这种乞讨行为。

sentences.en: And he doesn't even think that this approach works to solve the problem at all.
sentences.zh: 他甚至认为这种方法根本无法解决问题。

sentences.en: SIDS are small island development states.
sentences.zh: SIDS指的是小岛屿发展中国家。

sentences.en: So the minute you say to people that I represent a small island development state, what the other
sentences.zh: 所以，一旦你告诉人们我代表一个小岛屿发展中国家，其他人

sentences.en: people do is they pick you up in their head and they put you in the box of irrelevancy.
sentences.zh: 脑海中就会把你归入无关紧要的行列。

sentences.en: Because small island developing states.
sentences.zh: 因为小岛屿发展中国家。

sentences.en: All that tells them, if you speak to America and you say, I'm a small island development state, America is already looking past your head as to, who am I going to speak to next?
sentences.zh: 所有这些都在告诉他们，如果你跟美国对话并说，我是个小岛屿发展中国家，美国已经在越过你的头顶思考，我接下来要跟谁谈话？

sentences.en: Because this person is irrelevant to me.
sentences.zh: 因为这个人对我不重要。

sentences.en: He actually had to think bigger.
sentences.zh: 他实际上必须把眼光放得更高。

sentences.en: And the way I try to bring it home to people in Caribbean islands is I say, you add up the
sentences.zh: 我向加勒比岛屿的人们阐明这一点的方式是，我说，你把

sentences.en: population of all the SIDS in the world, you get to one less than one percent of the world's population.
sentences.zh: 世界上所有小岛屿发展中国家的人口加起来，还不到世界人口的百分之一。

sentences.en: The world is not going to change its international financial architecture for one percent of the population.
sentences.zh: 世界不会为了百分之一的人口改变其国际金融架构。

sentences.en: So I created a new coalition.
sentences.zh: 所以我创建了一个新的联盟。

sentences.en: And the phrase, the front line, was something I introduced about two years ago.
sentences.zh: 而“最前线”这个词是我大约两年前引入的。

sentences.en: He needed to think about a broader plan that would be applicable and relevant to countries all over the world that are suffering from similar disasters.
sentences.zh: 他需要考虑一个更广泛的计划，该计划对于世界各地遭受类似灾难的国家都具有适用性和相关性。

sentences.en: Basically, he sees the entire tropics as the front lines of the climate crisis today.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他将整个热带地区视为当今气候危机的最前线。

sentences.en: And we say the front line is between the tropics of Cancer and Capricorn.
sentences.zh: 我们说最前线位于北回归线和南回归线之间。

sentences.en: And what I'm doing there is saying, I'm not one percent of the world's population.
sentences.zh: 我在那里所做的是在说，我不是世界人口的百分之一。

sentences.en: I'm 3.3 billion people.
sentences.zh: 我是33亿人。

sentences.en: 3.3 billion people, 40 percent of the world's population are all in the same band together.
sentences.zh: 33亿人，占世界人口百分之四十的人都在同一个阵营里。

sentences.en: And now Mia is fighting not for one tiny island, 14 miles by 22 with 300,000 people in it, but for 3.3 billion people.
sentences.zh: 现在，米娅不再仅仅为一个14英里乘22英里、拥有30万人口的小岛而战，而是为33亿人而战。

sentences.en: And so it's with those two big ideas in mind, not just asking for money and not making it
sentences.zh: 正是在这两大理念的指引下，不仅不只是要钱，也不仅仅

sentences.en: just about tiny island nations, that he helps develop what becomes the Bridgetown Initiative.
sentences.zh: 局限于微小岛国，他协助制定了后来的《布里奇敦倡议》。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: So he's basically saying you can't just ask rich countries to pay out tons of money to tiny poor countries, even if it's true that they were the ones that caused climate change
sentences.zh: 所以他基本上是说，你不能仅仅要求富裕国家向贫穷小国支付巨额资金，即使气候变化主要确实是他们造成的

sentences.en: for the most part, that that is just a losing strategy.
sentences.zh: 这一事实成立，这种策略也注定会失败。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So in this plan, he's figuring out a way to use the regular system of banking, loans, not charity.
sentences.zh: 因此在这个计划中，他正在寻找一种方法来利用常规的银行系统、贷款，而不是慈善。

sentences.en: And he's making this about a significantly bigger part of the world in a way that rich countries really can't ignore.
sentences.zh: 他让这关乎世界上更大一部分地区，富裕国家确实无法忽视这一点。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And to actually get the specifics of this plan down on paper, Avinash called together a meeting
sentences.zh: 为了将该计划的具体细节落实在纸面上，阿维纳什今年夏天在布里奇敦召集了一次会议

sentences.en: this past summer in Bridgetown with senior economists, senior foundation leaders, senior leaders from the United Nations, himself and Prime Minister Motley, and actually hashed it
sentences.zh: 与会者包括资深经济学家、资深基金会领导人、联合国高级官员、他自己以及莫特利总理，大家进行了深入探讨

sentences.en: out.
sentences.zh: 并最终敲定。

sentences.en: Okay, so who do they need to convince to make this happen?
sentences.zh: 好吧，那么他们需要说服谁来让这一切成为现实呢？

sentences.en: Well, you might think the people you'd need to convince are the heads of these institutions, people like David Malpass, the president of the World Bank.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你可能会认为你需要说服的人是这些机构的负责人，比如世界银行行长大卫·马拉帕斯。

sentences.en: And David Malpass has actually been in the news quite a lot over the last several months, in large part because of an interview I did with him in September.
sentences.zh: 大卫·马拉帕斯在过去几个月里实际上占据了很多新闻头条，很大程度上是因为我在9月份对他进行了一次采访。

sentences.en: In that interview, I asked him if he believed in the basic facts of climate science.
sentences.zh: 在那次采访中，我问他是否相信气候科学的基本事实。

sentences.en: And his response was, I'm not a scientiSt.
sentences.zh: 他的回答是，我不是科学家。

sentences.en: Uh-oh.
sentences.zh: 噢哦。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So it would be good to get him on board.
sentences.zh: 所以争取他加入会是一件好事。

sentences.en: But the truth is, the people who actually matter more here are the shareholders of the
sentences.zh: 但事实是，这里真正更重要的人是世界银行的股东

sentences.en: World Bank, the United States, Japan, China, Germany, the United Kingdom, France.
sentences.zh: 美国、日本、中国、德国、英国、法国。

sentences.en: These are the key shareholders of the World Bank.
sentences.zh: 这些是世界银行的关键股东。

sentences.en: And ultimately, if these big fundamental reforms are going to be undertaken, those are the countries that need to be commenced.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，如果要进行这些重大的根本性改革，需要说服的正是这些国家。

sentences.en: And so that's why Prime Minister Motley was at COP27 with all of those countries gathered there trying to convince the people who matter to undertake this big systemic reform.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么莫特利总理带着所有这些国家聚集在《联合国气候变化框架公约》第二十七次缔约方大会（COP27）上，试图说服举足轻重的人来推行这一重大的系统性改革。

sentences.en: So how does it go?
sentences.zh: 那么进展如何呢？

sentences.en: Well, she thought she was going to be out of there before.
sentences.zh: 嗯，她原以为自己之前就能离开。

sentences.en: One o'clock now, and there's like 36 presidents that have to speak.
sentences.zh: 现在已经一点了，还有大约36位总统要发言。

sentences.en: Jeez.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: So on that first day of COP27, she gave that big speech, where she makes her pitch to the world.
sentences.zh: 所以在COP27的第一天，她发表了那场重大的演讲，向全世界阐述了她的构想。

sentences.en: But even then, as we heard it, it was unclear how it was being received by other world leaders.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，正如我们所听到的，其他世界领导人对它的接受程度尚不明确。

sentences.en: I lost where they went.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他们去哪儿了。

sentences.en: I mean, I suspect they may have just hightailed it for the exit.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我怀疑他们可能直接溜之大吉了。

sentences.en: We don't know how she was feeling about it, or what was going on on the sidelines or behind the scenes.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道她对此作何感想，或者场外和幕后发生了什么。

sentences.en: So we were desperately trying to get to her and Avi, and we spent a good amount of time trying to track them down.
sentences.zh: 所以我们拼命想联系上她和埃维，我们花了很多时间试图追踪他们的行踪。

sentences.en: Japan, South Africa, India, Qatar, Korea, Canada.
sentences.zh: 日本、南非、印度、卡塔尔、韩国、加拿大。

sentences.en: And so we raced across this enormous, sprawling network of conference centers to see if we could catch up with her there.
sentences.zh: 于是我们在庞大错综复杂的会议中心网络中穿梭，看能否在那里追上她。

sentences.en: Scotland.
sentences.zh: 苏格兰。

sentences.en: There's Scotland.
sentences.zh: 苏格兰在那里。

sentences.en: Hey, there we go.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我们走吧。

sentences.en: Okay, we are at the Scottish Pavilion, where Mia Motley is going to speak with a couple of other people in about 20 minutes.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们在苏格兰展馆，大约20分钟后，米娅·莫特利将在这里与另外几个人进行交流。

sentences.en: And so we finally caught up with her at the Scottish Pavilion.
sentences.zh: 于是我们终于在苏格兰展馆追上了她。

sentences.en: And we got seats in the front row.
sentences.zh: 我们在前排找到了座位。

sentences.en: She's there on this super high-powered panel, and she's explaining more about what she's envisioning with the Bridgetown Initiative.
sentences.zh: 她出席了这个阵容极其强大的座谈会，并进一步解释了她对《布里奇敦倡议》的构想。

sentences.en: And we're kind of anxiously sitting there, hoping we'll be able to get to her afterward, to ask her how this is all going.
sentences.zh: 我们焦虑地坐在那里，希望能有机会在会后接近她，询问她这一切进展如何。

sentences.en: Our vision does not have a written return to the break.
sentences.zh: 我们的愿景没有书面回归中场休息。

sentences.en: It was a mob scene with people trying to corner her and take pictures with her and talk to her and hand her her business cards.
sentences.zh: 现场成了一片混乱的人群，大家试图围住她、和她拍照、和她交谈、把名片递给她。

sentences.en: It is an absolute scrum right now, as everyone tries to take a picture of this quite high-profile panel of women we just heard.
sentences.zh: 现在绝对是一场混战，每个人都试图拍下我们刚刚听到的这个备受瞩目的女性座谈会。

sentences.en: And we were initially sort of getting jostled around, but ultimately, we secured ourselves right next to her and Avi, and were able to walk with them as they went to their next
sentences.zh: 我们最初有点被挤来挤去，但最终我们设法站到了她和埃维的旁边，并能够在他们前往下一个

sentences.en: appointment and finally got the chance to actually speak with Prime Minister Motley one-on-one.
sentences.zh: 预约地点的途中陪伴他们，终于有机会与莫特利总理进行了一对一的交谈。

sentences.en: Hi, Prime Minister Motley.
sentences.zh: 你好，莫特利总理。

sentences.en: David Gellis with The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的大卫·盖利斯。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Not bad.
sentences.zh: 还不错。

sentences.en: I was a stamper.
sentences.zh: 我曾是个图章制作者。

sentences.en: I was there for the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 大流行期间我在那儿。

sentences.en: Yeah, in Barbados.
sentences.zh: 是的，在巴巴多斯。

sentences.en: Indeed, yeah.
sentences.zh: 确实，是的。

sentences.en: So very, very much appreciated.
sentences.zh: 所以非常非常感激。

sentences.en: So when are you coming back?
sentences.zh: 那么你什么时候回来？

sentences.en: We've already been back.
sentences.zh: 我们已经回去了。

sentences.en: Yeah, but when are you coming back to live?
sentences.zh: 对，但你什么时候回来长住？

sentences.en: As soon as I can.
sentences.zh: 只要我能脱身。

sentences.en: I asked Prime Minister Motley how she felt like her message was being received.
sentences.zh: 我问莫特利总理她觉得自己的信息反响如何。

sentences.en: Is this something you feel is finally gaining traction?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这终于开始受到关注了吗？

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: I think we're quietly confident.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们暗自充满信心。

sentences.en: We're certainly getting a lot of positive feedback.
sentences.zh: 我们确实收到了很多积极的反馈。

sentences.en: And we'll continue to do the engagements that are necessary.
sentences.zh: 我们将继续开展必要的互动。

sentences.en: Are the challenges active resistance or something more like passivity and apathy?
sentences.zh: 挑战是来自积极的抵抗，还是更偏向于被动和冷漠？

sentences.en: No, I wouldn't say active resistance.
sentences.zh: 不，我不会说是积极的抵抗。

sentences.en: I think we're just trying to get as many people as possible and to really see what potentially could be the obstacles.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们只是在努力争取尽可能多的人支持，并真正弄清楚潜在的障碍可能是什么。

sentences.en: Because a lot of what we're putting there is so basic, I'm sorry to say, and so full of common sense that for them to be rejected at this point doesn't make sense when the opposite
sentences.zh: 因为我们提出的很多东西都太基础了，恕我直言，充满了常识，在这个阶段遭到拒绝是说不通的，而拒绝它的对立面

sentences.en: or the consequences of rejecting it will in fact be loss of lives and loss of livelihoods.
sentences.zh: 或者说拒绝它的后果实际上将是生命的丧失和生计的断绝。

sentences.en: I mean, the world can't be in this polycrisis moment and we not find a way to be able to finance our way out of it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，世界不能处于这种多重危机时刻而我们却找不到资金来摆脱困境。

sentences.en: We're not asking for money to do things that are, you know, trivial.
sentences.zh: 我们索要资金并不是为了做那些你知道的微不足道的事情。

sentences.en: We're asking for money to be able to ensure that we can recover from climate crisis, that
sentences.zh: 我们索要资金是为了确保我们能够从气候危机中恢复过来

sentences.en: we can build resilience for climate crisis, that we can better prepare for the next pandemic, that we can invest in education and health.
sentences.zh: 为了让我们能够增强应对气候危机的韧性，为了让我们更好地为下一次大流行做准备，为了让我们能够在教育和健康方面进行投资。

sentences.en: Those of us who are the victims of the climate crisis cannot continue to crowd out all of
sentences.zh: 我们这些气候危机的受害者不能继续挤占我们资产负债表上的所有

sentences.en: the space we have on our balance sheet, just to prepare for something that we didn't cause.
sentences.zh: 空间，仅仅是为了应对一件我们并未造成的事情。

sentences.en: Thank you, Prime Minister.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，总理女士。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: And of course, there at Prime Minister Motley's side was Avi.
sentences.zh: 当然，陪伴在莫特利总理身边的还有埃维。

sentences.en: Avi, may we walk and talk with you just on your way?
sentences.zh: 埃维，我们在路上边走边跟你聊聊好吗？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 行。

sentences.en: How do you feel like the message has been received?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这个信息反响如何？

sentences.en: Do you feel like the right people are hearing it?
sentences.zh: 你觉得听取它的人对路了吗？

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: I think there is actually a strong potential, real potential.
sentences.zh: 我认为确实存在强大的潜力，真正的潜力。

sentences.en: I think you will find people saying that never before has there been such momentum around one set of ideas.
sentences.zh: 你会发现人们在说，从来没有围绕一整套理念形成过如此强大的势头。

sentences.en: Whether that will end up, we will get to land it.
sentences.zh: 不管最终结果如何，我们将如何落地。

sentences.en: Whether it is the right set.
sentences.zh: 不管它是否是正确的一套。

sentences.en: But I think there's a pretty strong view that never before has there been this much consensus and momentum around one set of ideas.
sentences.zh: 但我认为有一个相当强烈的观点，即从来没有对这样一套理念产生过如此多的共识和势头。

sentences.en: And I think it's because we were...
sentences.zh: 我想这是因为我们...

sentences.en: And he too seems to think that this is breaking through.
sentences.zh: 他也觉得这正在取得突破。

sentences.en: And do you think that's true, that it is breaking through?
sentences.zh: 你认为这是真的吗，它真的取得了突破？

sentences.en: Like, are you guys feeling like it really is?
sentences.zh: 比如，你们真的有这种感觉吗？

sentences.en: Well, obviously, the hardcore climate change activists liked what they were hearing.
sentences.zh: 很明显，坚定的气候变化活动人士喜欢他们所听到的一切。

sentences.en: We need to reconvene Bretton Woods and completely revamp and reform the World Bank system and make access to private capital available for developing countries.
sentences.zh: 我们需要重新召集布雷顿森林会议，彻底改组和改革世界银行系统，并让发展中国家能够获得私人资本。

sentences.en: But as the week went on, we started to learn that people like French President Macron was on board, too.
sentences.zh: 但随着一周过去，我们开始了解到，法国总统马克龙等人也加入了进来。

sentences.en: France is one of the top shareholders of the World Bank, so that was an endorsement that really mattered.
sentences.zh: 法国是世界银行的主要股东之一，所以这是一个非常重要的背书。

sentences.en: And then we were like, wait, maybe this thing is catching on.
sentences.zh: 然后我们想，等等，也许这事真的开始流行了。

sentences.en: And then on Wednesday, I ran in to the head of the IMF and I asked her about what would be a fundamental change to her own institution.
sentences.zh: 接着在周三，我遇到了国际货币基金组织（IMF）总裁，我向她询问了关于对其自身机构进行根本性变革的问题。

sentences.en: From your perspective, is there really momentum among the shareholders, who are ultimately the decision makers, to make the changes that will make juSt...
sentences.zh: 从你的角度来看，最终作为决策者的股东们之间，是否真的有动力去做出能够让...

sentences.en: There is, there is.
sentences.zh: 确实，确实如此。

sentences.en: And she basically said yes.
sentences.zh: 她基本上同意了。

sentences.en: And then using it to unlock private finance on scale.
sentences.zh: 然后利用它来大规模撬动私人资本。

sentences.en: I mean, that sounds like the Bridgetown agenda.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这听起来像是布里奇敦倡议。

sentences.en: That's exactly what it is.
sentences.zh: 完全就是这样。

sentences.en: So are you supportive of the Bridgetown agenda?
sentences.zh: 那你支持布里奇敦倡议吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I am supportive of everything we can do.
sentences.zh: 是的，我支持我们能做的一切。

sentences.en: Everything we can do.
sentences.zh: 我们能做的一切。

sentences.en: And more surprisingly, even senior members of the financial sector seem to be supporting this project.
sentences.zh: 更令人惊讶的是，甚至金融界的高层似乎也在支持这个项目。

sentences.en: We have to get these multilateral development banks, and they're very different.
sentences.zh: 我们必须让这些多边开发银行行动起来，它们各不相同。

sentences.en: Some are more aggressive, some are less aggressive.
sentences.zh: 有些更激进，有些则比较保守。

sentences.en: To use their capital, unleash a lot more capital.
sentences.zh: 利用它们的资本，释放出更多的资本。

sentences.en: Including the chief executive of Bank of America.
sentences.zh: 包括美国银行的首席执行官。

sentences.en: So Prime Minister Motley has been leading that charge.
sentences.zh: 所以莫特利总理一直在带头推动此事。

sentences.en: We're going to do a session a little later today with President Macron on it.
sentences.zh: 我们今天晚些时候将与马克龙总统就此举行一场会议。

sentences.en: But it's, the concept's been around, it's now time for the governments, the shareholders and these institutions to change their charters and allow them to help.
sentences.zh: 但这个概念已经存在一段时间了，现在是时候让各国政府、股东和这些机构改变它们的章程，允许它们发挥作用了。

sentences.en: And the private sector will come in right behind them.
sentences.zh: 而私营部门会紧随其后介入。

sentences.en: They're juSt...
sentences.zh: 他们只是……

sentences.en: And that kind of endorsement really matters.
sentences.zh: 这种程度的背书真的很重要。

sentences.en: Because those are the institutions that people hope will be putting up more of their money.
sentences.zh: 因为这些机构正是人们希望它们能投入更多资金的地方。

sentences.en: And we were like, this thing actually seems to be gaining traction.
sentences.zh: 当时我们的感觉是，这件事似乎真的开始受到关注了。

sentences.en: It might actually happen.
sentences.zh: 它可能真的会发生。

sentences.en: And then by the end of the week, John Kerry, President Biden's special envoy for climate, says he's on board too.
sentences.zh: 然后到周末的时候，拜登总统的气候问题特使约翰·克里也表示他赞同。

sentences.en: We absolutely need to have multilateral development bank reform.
sentences.zh: 我们绝对需要对多边开发银行进行改革。

sentences.en: We need to do it by the next spring meeting of the banks.
sentences.zh: 我们需要在银行的下一次春季会议之前完成这项工作。

sentences.en: And if it happens, then we have something like $400 or $500 million that can then be used to leverage.
sentences.zh: 如果成功了，我们就会有大约4亿或5亿美元可以用来发挥杠杆作用。

sentences.en: That's real stuff.
sentences.zh: 这可是来真的。

sentences.en: That's beginning to get it done.
sentences.zh: 这开始付诸行动了。

sentences.en: So MDB reform is absolutely critical.
sentences.zh: 所以多边开发银行改革绝对至关重要。

sentences.en: And that is a big deal because the United States is the biggest shareholder of the World Bank.
sentences.zh: 这意义重大，因为美国是世界银行最大的股东。

sentences.en: And without the U.S.
sentences.zh: 如果没有美国

sentences.en: being on board, none of these reforms are going to happen.
sentences.zh: 的支持，这些改革都不可能实现。

sentences.en: But, okay, fine.
sentences.zh: 不过，好吧，也行。

sentences.en: You're not hearing any of them at a climate conference say that they oppose this very appealing climate plan.
sentences.zh: 你在气候大会上没听到任何人说他们反对这个极具吸引力的气候计划。

sentences.en: You know, everybody wants to agree with it, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，每个人都想表示赞同，对吧？

sentences.en: What about after the cameras are off and time passes and we actually get down to brass tacks?
sentences.zh: 那当镜头移开、时间流逝，我们真正开始讨论核心实质问题时呢？

sentences.en: Like, when the rubber hits the road, what are people going to say?
sentences.zh: 比如，当真正的考验来临时，大家会怎么说？

sentences.en: Well, so far, the real opposition seems to be inertia and bureaucracy.
sentences.zh: 嗯，到目前为止，真正的阻力似乎来自惯性和官僚作风。

sentences.en: These are decades-old institutions that are very fixed in their ways.
sentences.zh: 这些都是存在了几十年的机构，行事方式非常僵化。

sentences.en: I have yet to find anyone, not any of the major shareholders, and not even any of the heads of the institutions themselves, coming out and saying that they oppose these plans.
sentences.zh: 我至今还没发现任何人——没有任何主要股东，甚至连这些机构的负责人自己——站出来说他们反对这些计划。

sentences.en: And Avi would tell you that the brilliance of this plan is that no countries have to shell out more money.
sentences.zh: 阿维会告诉你，这个计划的高明之处在于，不需要任何国家掏出更多的钱。

sentences.en: So, in his telling, there's not a lot of downside to any of this.
sentences.zh: 所以在他看来，这一切并没有什么太大的负面影响。

sentences.en: But as we've talked about, there is more risk.
sentences.zh: 但正如我们所讨论的，风险其实更大了。

sentences.en: All of these mean potentially riskier loans, and all of that makes this a potentially really hard sell at the end of the day,
sentences.zh: 所有这些都意味着贷款风险可能更高，归根结底，这使得它在推销时可能会异常艰难，

sentences.en: even to the shareholders who say right now that they're on board with these reforMs.
sentences.zh: 哪怕是对那些现在表示支持这些改革的股东来说也是如此。

sentences.en: So, we'll see.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们拭目以待吧。

sentences.en: But seriously, I'm not hearing any opposition, and that means a lot.
sentences.zh: 但说真的，我没有听到任何反对的声音，这分量很重。

sentences.en: David, I feel like this is a very strange place because it feels like what you're saying is that things actually might change.
sentences.zh: 大卫，我觉得这是一个很奇怪的局面，因为听起来你的意思是事情真的可能会发生改变。

sentences.en: In a pretty big way.
sentences.zh: 而且是以相当大的幅度。

sentences.en: And honestly, this feels kind of funny.
sentences.zh: 老实说，这感觉有点不可思议。

sentences.en: Because, you know, when I think of climate change, it is just this incredibly complicated, stuck problem that the world is facing.
sentences.zh: 因为你知道的，每当我想起气候变化，它就是这样一个极其复杂、陷入僵局、世界正在面对的难题。

sentences.en: And that, frankly, I don't feel that optimistic about.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我对它并不抱太大希望。

sentences.en: I hear you.
sentences.zh: 我懂你的意思。

sentences.en: But I think the reason that this plan is breaking through is that it's actually using the existing global financial system to try to address this crisis that for so long has felt so intractable.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这个计划能够取得突破，是因为它实际上在利用现有的全球金融体系来试图解决这个长期以来让人感觉无解的危机。

sentences.en: This isn't climate reparations.
sentences.zh: 这不是气候赔偿。

sentences.en: It's not a loss and damage fund.
sentences.zh: 这不是损失和损害基金。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's the market.
sentences.zh: 这是市场。

sentences.en: The thing that makes the world go around, right?
sentences.zh: 让世界运转的东西，对吧？

sentences.en: And they're working within it instead of fighting against it.
sentences.zh: 他们是在顺应它运作，而不是与之对抗。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: David, how do you imagine the world would change if this does happen?
sentences.zh: 大卫，如果这一切真的发生了，你想象世界会发生怎样的改变？

sentences.en: Like, what would it look like?
sentences.zh: 比如，会是什么样子？

sentences.en: Well, let's be clear.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们要搞清楚一点。

sentences.en: Even if everything we're talking about happens, it's not going to solve the climate crisis.
sentences.zh: 即使我们讨论的所有事情都发生了，它也不会彻底解决气候危机。

sentences.en: It's not going to make carbon emissions stop on a dime.
sentences.zh: 它不会让碳排放戛然而止。

sentences.en: And it's not going to stop the planet from warming anytime soon.
sentences.zh: 它也不会在短期内阻止地球变暖。

sentences.en: But at the end of the day, we're talking about money here.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，我们在这里谈论的是钱。

sentences.en: What it would mean if these reforms really took place is that poor and vulnerable countries would have more funds at their disposal.
sentences.zh: 如果这些改革真的落实，意味着贫穷和脆弱国家将拥有更多可调配的资金。

sentences.en: And more funds to use in order to recover from storms and fires and floods.
sentences.zh: 有更多资金用于从风暴、火灾和洪水中恢复。

sentences.en: More funds to prepare for future disasters by building things like seawalls or preparing their schools and hospitals and making them more resilient to large,
sentences.zh: 有更多资金通过修建海堤等设施，或者让学校和医院做好准备，提高它们应对大规模、

sentences.en: unpredictable weather events.
sentences.zh: 不可预测的天气事件的韧性，来为未来的灾害做准备。

sentences.en: And it would also mean that those poor countries that have been trapped in this cycle of debt and disaster maybe had some of the pressure taken off when it came to servicing that debt.
sentences.zh: 这也意味着那些陷入债务与灾难循环的贫穷国家，在偿还债务时可能会减轻一些压力。

sentences.en: That they maybe didn't always have to worry about paying back their creditors before they did things like take care of the people who were just displaced because of the latest hurricane.
sentences.zh: 他们可能不必总是在做诸如照顾刚刚因最新飓风而流离失所的人这类事情之前，先去担心如何偿还债权人。

sentences.en: And Prime Minister Motley and Avi and everyone beating the drum about these reforms is quick to point out that this is in the interest of countries like the United States,
sentences.zh: 莫特利总理、阿维以及所有为这些改革大声疾呼的人都急忙指出，这符合美国等国家的利益，

sentences.en: that this is in the self-interest of France and Germany.
sentences.zh: 这符合法国和德国自身的利益。

sentences.en: And the reason why is because if these poor,
sentences.zh: 原因就在于，如果这些贫穷、

sentences.en: vulnerable nations continue to be trapped in this cycle of debt and disaster and continue to have such a hard time rising out of poverty,
sentences.zh: 脆弱的国家继续陷入债务和灾难的循环，继续难以摆脱贫困，

sentences.en: that's going to create even more cascading economic issues for these countries that they're still going to have to deal with one day down the line,
sentences.zh: 那将为这些国家带来更多呈级联反应的经济问题，未来某天它们终究还是要应对这些问题，

sentences.en: whether it is through disaster relief or more debt or unpredictable geopolitical consequences of more and more countries destabilized by the climate crisis.
sentences.zh: 无论是通过救灾、更多的债务，还是越来越多国家因气候危机陷入不稳定而带来的不可预测的地缘政治后果。

sentences.en: David, if this all actually does come to pass, it feels a little bit like we'd be living in a kind of third era of global economic cooperation.
sentences.zh: 大卫，如果这一切真的实现了，感觉有点像是我们生活在某种第三次全球经济合作时代。

sentences.en: Like the first one was the world coming together after the Second World War.
sentences.zh: 就像第一次是二战后世界走到一起。

sentences.en: The second one was the world coming together to bring poor nations out of poverty.
sentences.zh: 第二次是世界携手将贫困国家拉出贫困线。

sentences.en: And the third one would be this development of a system that fully incorporates climate change into global finance, like makes a sustainable way to pay for all of this.
sentences.zh: 而第三次将是建立这样一个系统：将气候变化完全纳入全球金融体系，比如找到一种可持续的方式来支付所有这些费用。

sentences.en: And that would really be a first for decades now, countries have understood that climate change is real.
sentences.zh: 这真的将是史无前例的——几十年来，各国一直明白气候变化是真实的。

sentences.en: And for decades now, they've been trying these piecemeal, sporadic, ad hoc approaches to dealing with these disasters.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，他们一直尝试用这种零敲碎打、断断续续、临时凑合的方法来应对这些灾害。

sentences.en: There has never been a coordinated,
sentences.zh: 从来没有过一次协调一致、

sentences.en: unified effort to try to get the powers of the world and all the money that they possess directed at the countries that need it most with the intent of making the world more resilient to climate change as a whole.
sentences.zh: 统一的努力，试图让世界大国的力量以及它们拥有的所有资金，对准那些最需要的国家，其目的是全面提高世界应对气候变化的韧性。

sentences.en: If all these reforms happen, if hundreds of billions or trillions of dollars are taken off the sidelines and started to be used for some of these projects,
sentences.zh: 如果所有这些改革都得以实现，如果有数千亿甚至数万亿美元不再闲置，并开始用于其中一些项目，

sentences.en: that would, by the estimates of a lot of longtime climate change experts, represent one of the most fundamental and historic efforts to really combat climate change
sentences.zh: 那么根据许多长期气候变化专家的估计，这将代表着人类为真正抗击气候变化所做出的最根本、最具历史意义的努力之一，

sentences.en: and help the people who need it most deal with what is an unprecedented threat.
sentences.zh: 并帮助最需要的人应对史无前例的威胁。

sentences.en: David, thank you.
sentences.zh: 大卫，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: In China, several cities announced the easing of lockdown restrictions and testing requirements.
sentences.zh: 在中国，几个城市宣布放宽封锁限制和检测要求。

sentences.en: In Guangzhou, residents returned to work on Thursday for the first time in weeks since the COVID-19 lockdowns were lifted.
sentences.zh: 在广州，随着新冠疫情封锁解除，居民在周四几周来首次重返工作岗位。

sentences.en: In Chongqing, some residents were no longer required to take regular COVID tests.
